summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: Zebu's touchline snapshot (tk) gives a Quote frame with every quote field, a partial update (tf) overlays it and its zero open keeps the cached one, and after the unsubscribe a frame still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Noren's feed time ft goes out as the member's timestamp key in seconds, as on the web; its trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS) is not copied as text, and the Noren family sends no ltt key (docs/port/market-data-frames.md; audit FB-07).

deviations.reason: Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Zebu Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
